decompose_when: multiple independent ownership domains must mutate
a Work Order cannot state a finite acceptance predicate set
review requires unrelated expertise or trust domains
a failure would make rollback scope ambiguous
the task exceeds the current context budget
parallel read-only research can safely unblock later mutation
completion_rule: A parent mission completes only after every required child checkpoint and integration predicate is durably proven; no child role may declare the parent complete by prose.
